Az=(Ap-Ap.mean(0))/Ap.std(0); Bz=(Bp-Bp.mean(0))/Bp.std(0)
print(' k   corr(a_k,b_k)  #(a>2sd & b>2sd)  #(a>2sd & b<-2sd)  expected_if_indep   sd_b')
K=len(cl)
for k in range(K):
    r=np.corrcoef(Ap[:,k],Bp[:,k])[0,1]
